entries.name: Toon dread ponytail (tiko479, CC0)
entries.notes: Static mesh — 6 meshes, 3 embedded images. Must be rigged to the Head bone before use. 3 texture variants included (multicolored / solid / gradient) as swappable options.

source: CC0, tiko479, https://Opengameart.org/content/toonlow-poly-dread-ponytail. Staged 2026-10-08 in ~/workspace/customization-pulls/hair/toon_dread_ponytail/. Pruned .blend/.fbx/.obj/.dae/.stl/.mtl; GLB kept.

universal_format.description: Every hair entry is a GLB mesh part meant to attach to the head. To use on a character: rig (or re-target) the mesh to that character's Head bone, pick one of the entry's texture PNGs as the diffuse. No body geometry changes — attach-only, so it drops onto any character once rigged to its skeleton.

variants_rule: New dreads variants = new entries + new files. Nothing here is overwritten.
